description: Computes structural diffs between any two git commits at the architectural level. Extracts graph snapshots via detached-HEAD worktrees. Diffs operate on semantic IDs (file-path-independent), producing six operation types. Diffs compose transitively and hash deterministically.
label: Temporal Diffing

members.note: Creates a worktree at a commit, initialises CodeGraph, extracts the snapshot (nodes + edges + HTTP bridge), caches in SQLite, cleans up the worktree.
Compares two GraphSnapshot objects. Maps nodes by semantic ID. Detects add/remove/modify/move/rename for nodes, add/remove for edges.
Replays diff operations onto a snapshot. Validates base hash before applying.
Merges two sequential diffs (A to B, B to C) into one (A to C). Handles operation cancellation (add then remove equals no-op).
Version 2 format: base hash, target hash, diffHash, operations array.
Six-variant discriminated union: add_node, remove_node, modify_node, move_node, add_edge, remove_edge.
Deterministic SHA-256 of canonical JSON. Schwartzian sort by semantic ID.
Client entry point. Fetches snapshots via SSE, computes diff, builds merged view with status colouring.
